ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65-70% high-intensity (white) central fields versus 30-35% low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity fields occupy the center of both lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation forms a continuous band along the leading and trailing edges. A horizontal sequence of five discrete, circular low-intensity blobs is visible in the mid-region of the left lobe; the right lobe contains more dispersed, irregular low-intensity clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior pixel angle is approximately 55-65 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 20% into the vertical height of the fluke assembly.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration. The left lobe trailing edge features approximately 4-5 distinct peaks with deep intervening valleys. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a more irregular, finely jagged pixel boundary with lower amplitude variation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer leading margins exhibit strong convexity toward the tips. Trailing edges are generally linear with a subtle inward concavity as they approach the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a high-contrast constellation consisting of five circular dark-on-white spots in a linear horizontal arrangement on the left lobe; several smaller, less structured clusters are detected on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) breaking the white pigmentation; one prominent diagonal abrasion is located on the lower-left lobe, while several smaller horizontal marks are clustered on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks visible on both lobes; notable irregular tissue loss/notching on the distal portion of the left lobe's trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique linear 'dotted' pigmentation pattern on the left lobe ventral surface.
